question: Does a fixed CatBoost structured expert improve artifact_signal classification for stream-missing records when the present-stream C2_B expert is left unchanged?
candidate_expert: CatBoostClassifier on expanded structured features, trained on all rows in each past-only fit fold, routed only to stream-missing validation rows.
control_route: C4_HGB = archived C2_B for stream-present rows and archived C1_B for stream-missing rows.
candidate_route: C2_B remains unchanged for stream-present rows; CatBoost replaces C1_B only when signal_stream is blank or missing.

preprocessing.feature_allowlist: EXPANDED_FEATURES only; no signal_stream, record_id, target, or threat_rank.
preprocessing.numeric_and_count_fields: Reuse fit-only expanded parsing, numeric indicators, and median imputation from the verified _HGBPreprocessor.
preprocessing.category_input: Pass nonmissing raw categories as strings and missing values as a dedicated string sentinel to CatBoost native categorical processing. The expanded preprocessor's ordinal state is retained in the fit audit but not fed as ordinal numeric data to CatBoost.

metric: fixed-label [0,1] Macro F1 at fixed threshold 0.50
paired_missing_branch_diagnostics: Compare CatBoost and C1_B predictions at fixed 0.50 over the same stream-missing primary validation rows; report candidate-only correct, C1_B-only correct, net difference, and subgroup Macro F1/AP/Brier.

optional_fixed_blend.gate: Evaluate only if, on all stream-missing primary validation rows, CatBoost-only correct >= 25, C1_B-only correct >= 25, and CatBoost net correct-count delta >= 0.
optional_fixed_blend.blend: One 0.50 CatBoost / 0.50 C1_B probability blend on missing-stream rows only, threshold 0.50; present-stream C2_B remains unchanged. No blend or threshold search.

reporting: Pooled and equal-cycle Macro F1, six per-window and per-cycle results, confusion matrix, fixed-label per-class precision/recall/F1, AP, Brier, present/missing subgroup coverage. Public Test/Kaggle are not used.
adaptation_warning: Cycles 56-79 were previously used in model development. All comparisons are adaptive development evidence, not an untouched holdout.
official_test_policy: Do not read, fit, predict, score, or submit official Test data.
